api.build-record: inputs {:target :declaration {:path :expected-sha256?} :base-revision {:repo :sha} :observe}. :declaration nil => lookup by :target in the classpath cascade-sources dir; no hit => typed absent record. :observe defaults to the real C4 check futon2.aif.observation-checks/check-decl-in-file and is the injection point for unit tests and replay. Always returns a record with :schema :wm/selected-effect-declaration-v1, :record/digest and :admission; typed refusals are carried in the record, never thrown.
api.verify-record: structural integrity AND authority: digest re-derivation through the existing action-identity canonical printer (proving total EDN), no legacy declaration fields, exact schema, want ownership/census, admission consistent with content, base-revision consistency.
api.reconstruct: validates the supplied record, rebuilds from the same inputs, and requires full canonical body equality plus digest equality.
api.record-digest: sha256 over [:wm/selected-effect-declaration-v1 (action-identity/canonical body)] using action-identity/printed + sha256; :schema is covered, :record/digest is not.

record-schema.:base-revision: {:repo .. :sha <pinned reference>} plus :resolved-sha once any observation resolved it
record-schema.:horizon: {:status :declared :value N :authority :declaration/horizon-steps} | {:status :absent :reason :horizon-not-declared} — never defaulted to cascade length
record-schema.:wants: authored :want tokens as [target token] pairs; only :want is read, never :facts
record-schema.:want-observations: {:active [{:want :locator :locator-class :observation}] :excluded-already-true [{:want :observation}] :unknown [{:want :locator-class :observation}]} — every declared want appears in exactly one bucket
record-schema.:excluded-already-true / :active-wants: token lists mirroring the buckets (already-true listed with its observation, never silently dropped)
record-schema.observation-rows: {:status :observed :observed-before bool :check :C4 :evidence {.. :resolved-sha ..}} | {:status :unknown :kind :missing-locator|:unsupported-locator-class|:contradictory-observation|:observation-not-boolean|:observation-evidence-mismatch|<reader kind> :reader-result/expected ..}. An unknown row is NEVER observed-before false; evidence must prove the exact locator, C4 check and base reference.

limits: Pure producer/validator only. Nothing consumes the record yet: no occurrence-mint binding, no admission check, no selected-want-outcome/falsifier change. The future runner binding goes into the occurrence context, not the scoring certificate, and is out of this packet.
Only :want (not :facts) is read for wants, so a declaration whose authored selection lives in :facts cannot be admitted — intentional.

Evidence validation proves the reader read the requested locator at the requested reference; with an INJECTED reader a test can still supply fabricated-but-well-formed evidence (that is what injection means). Production authority comes from the default real C4 check.
Only the C4 locator class is interpreted; a future class needs explicit support and tests.
The declaration is read from the file on disk (pinned by byte sha256), not at the base revision; historical declaration authorship is not reconstructed.
:base-revision :resolved-sha comes from the first observed row; with zero observed rows the reference stays unresolved.
